pages.text: Apply spatial modifiers, then evaluate the child selector in the resulting spatial frame.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Only the connected nodes contribute; this node adds no mana fee.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: Add the complexity of the attached modifiers and selector.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)modifiers$(br)Modifier / Add up to 64 nodes$(br2)$(li)child$(br)Selector / Insert one node
